caption: The drawing depicts three elongated metal fireplace tools arranged vertically against a plain, off-white background. Each tool features a similarly styled handle that is ornate, cylindrical, and metallic, with a yellow-brass coloration. On the left is a pair of tongs with two long prongs, slightly curved ends, and a rounded hinge near the top below the handle. In the center is a poker, shown with its front-facing side, which displays two symmetrical arms connected by a circular floral medallion below the handle, and the lower part splits into two straight prongs. On the right is a shovel with a similar ornate handle, a narrow shaft, and a broad, flat, rectangular scoop at the end. Both silver-grey and brass tones are used throughout the tools to differentiate the metal types and details. Below the central tool are two horizontal measuring scales marked in feet and inches. The bottom-left corner contains the name "HANS KORSCH" written in capital letters. The entire image is bordered by a thin black line forming a rectangle around the composition.
title: Fire Shovel and Tongs
